text: dsh-rich-context 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，在侧边栏提供上下文管理面板。它通过主机路由读取和保存用户全局及工作区的 AGENTS.md 指令文件，也支持自定义路径；面板还可编辑可复用提示词，并在输入框用 @名称插入提示词。适合希望集中维护 agent 规则、按项目区分指令或复用常用提示词的 DSH 用户。安装命令为 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rich-context；无需 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-rich-context is a DSH web plugin for editing global, workspace, or custom-path AGENTS.md files from a sidebar. It also saves reusable prompts and inserts them into the composer with @name. Install with dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rich-context; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里直接编辑全局和项目各自的 AGENTS.md。
我想把常用提示词保存起来，需要时从输入框快速插入。
Can I manage agent instruction files for all sessions and individual workspaces from one place?
dsh-rich-context 的功能「指令文件编辑」：在侧边栏面板读取和保存全局或所选工作区的 AGENTS.md，也可指定自定义绝对路径加载文件并保存内容。
dsh-rich-context 的功能「提示词库」：在面板新建、编辑或删除提示词；在 DSH 输入框键入 @ 和关键词筛选条目，选中后将提示词正文插入输入内容。

dsh-rich-context README · dsh-rich-context：**Agent instruction manager for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** — edit, refine, and route the `AGENTS.md` files your agents actually read, from a sidebar panel under the Skill Center.

> 管理 AGENTS.md——agent 实际读取的指令文件：全局/工作区编辑、自定义路径、跨工具源扫描与默认切换。

dsh-rich-context README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rich-context
```

Restart the `dsh web` process. A **Context** entry appears in the sidebar (under Skill Center).

dsh-rich-context README · What it manages：The harness reads instruction files from two scopes (verified in `dsh-agent-instructions`):
- **User-global**: `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` — injected into every session
- **Per-workspace**: `<workspace-root>/AGENTS.md` — scoped to that workspace's sessions

Plus **custom paths** — click the path in the header to route to any absolute file path.

dsh-rich-context README · The panel：Two tabs (segmented, bleed grammar):

- **Global** — edit `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` with the monospace editor (Ctrl+S saves)
- **Workspace** — pick a workspace from the dropdown, edit its root `AGENTS.md`

The **path field** in the header is click-to-edit: click it, type any absolute path, Enter to load that file instead. The editor follows.

dsh-rich-context README · Source scanning + default switching：On the Global tab, the **AGENTS.md sources** section scans 10 tool directories (`.dsh`, `.codex`, `.claude`, `.omp`, `.pi`, `.cursor`, `.aider`, `.gemini`, `.copilot`, `.continue` — plus home root) for `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` files. Each detected file lists with its line count and a **Set as default** button — clicking it **symlinks** `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` to that file, so the harness transparently reads whichever tool's instructions you designate as the single source of truth. Reset restores a plain file.

                       routes. Scans tool dirs, manages symlinks, reads/writes
                       AGENTS.md files. Node builtins only.
